title: activation-tactics.playbook-step template variables
description: Values for templates/activation-tactics.playbook-step.md.j2 and templates/activation-tactics.playbook-step.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from activation-tactics.playbook-step.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

activation_event_name.title: Activation event name
activation_event_name.description: The tracked activation event (snake_case) every tactic moves users toward. From section 'Activation'.

step_conversion_baseline.title: Step conversion baseline
step_conversion_baseline.description: The target step's current conversion as a ratio 0..1, from the activation-metrics report. From section 'Measured drop-offs'.

target_step.title: Target step
target_step.description: The measured drop-off step the first tactic targets. From section 'Measured drop-offs'.

window_days.title: Window days
window_days.description: Activation window in days from signup. From section 'Activation'.
